profile.name: THAI AUTO TOOLS AND DIE PUBLIC COMPANY LIMITED
profile.businessType: Design and manufacture of tooling for the automotive industry, including the design and production of stamping dies, checking fixtures, assembly jigs, and the manufacturing of automotive press parts.
profile.address: 45/6, 45/9 Moo 11, Khubangluang Subdistrict, Latlumkaeo District Pathum Thani 12140
profile.dividendPolicy: The company has a dividend policy to distribute dividends at a rate of not less than 40% of the net profit after corporate income tax, according to the separate financial statements, and after deducting all types of reserves as required by law and the company. The dividend payment should not significantly impact on the company's normal operations. Dividends are to be paid equally per share. Once the Board of Directors approves the dividend payment, it must be presented for approval at the shareholders' meeting, except for interim dividends, which the Board of Directors may approve from time to time if the company has sufficient profits. The interim dividend payment must be reported to the shareholders at the next shareholders' meeting.
